sources.details: 正确损失0、错误损失10，成功q的期望=(1−q)10；工具再加.02。qdirect.9得1，qtool.99得.12；qdirect.999得.01。额外cost需<(qtool−qdirect)10才tool更低；点数不是秒/美元。

artifacts.command: ["python", "-c", "direct_accuracy=.90;tool_accuracy=.99;wrong_cost=10.;tool_extra_cost=.02\ndirect_loss=(1-direct_accuracy)*wrong_cost;tool_loss=(1-tool_accuracy)*wrong_cost+tool_extra_cost\nprint('直接回答平均損失',round(direct_loss,3));print('工具流程平均損失',round(tool_loss,3));print('本例選擇','TOOL' if tool_loss<direct_loss else 'DIRECT')"]
